study_design: Age-matched case-control study with community-based and hospital-based controls
reason: The study evaluates incident, histologically confirmed prostate cancer overall. The abstract does not report an aggressive, high-grade, advanced, metastatic, or lethal endpoint.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Two hundred and fifty-three incident patients with histologically confirmed PCa and 419 (340 community-based and 79 hospital-based) controls, matched by age, were recruited in Ho Chi Minh City during 2013-2015.
estimate_classifications.reason: The tea estimate is for incident prostate cancer overall, not an aggressive subtype.
